name: redis
description: Redis client for DuckDB. Read, write, and scan keys/hashes/lists from any Redis server directly in SQL — strings, hashes, lists, key discovery, and bulk SCAN-then-HSCAN patterns.

cta.title: Talk to Redis from SQL
cta.description: Install Redis to GET/SET/HGET/HSET/SCAN against any Redis instance from inside DuckDB queries — including bulk discovery patterns for migration and analysis.
